checks.name: release and schema authority
checks.evidence: Engine 4.0.0 and Project Format 2 frozen schema 29 retain the visual/audio migration in TypeScript, Rust and Tauri.

checks.name: joined anti-protrusion outlines
checks.evidence: New shapes use a 0.04-unit stroke; Canvas2D uses joined strokes and WebGL2 emits a bounded-miter ring.

checks.name: renderer tier and recovery contract
checks.evidence: Capability query, explicit fallback and WebGL context loss/restoration/reset are connected.

checks.name: 2D renderer architecture
checks.evidence: WebGL2 tier reports batching, atlases, cameras, render textures, materials, lighting and particles; Canvas2D reports its supported fallback subset.

checks.name: render graph and comparable captures
checks.evidence: Render passes, targets, saved captures and pixel comparisons are available in Diagnostics.

checks.name: lighting authoring and masks
checks.evidence: Ambient/light/mask/occluder/shadow/normal-map paths and a focused Lighting panel are present.

checks.name: particle authoring and budget
checks.evidence: Shapes, curves, gradients, subemitters, preview and bounded project diagnostics are connected.

checks.name: typed materials and safe shaders
checks.evidence: Typed fields, texture/enum/range/toggle controls, includes, variants, cache, inheritance, live preview and bounded shader safety are connected.

checks.name: advanced text views are opt-in
checks.evidence: Raw JSON/source views are behind an explicit Advanced disclosure rather than the default workflow.

checks.name: explicit texture/font/audio import profiles
checks.evidence: Pixel/UI/normal/general texture, scalable/bitmap font and sound/music/voice/streaming audio profiles are editable and serialized.

checks.name: font pipeline reaches renderers
checks.evidence: Fallbacks/outlines flow into Canvas2D and WebGL cached text; browser text shaping remains enabled by import settings.

checks.name: audio authoring and runtime
checks.evidence: Preview/import, positional audio, effects graph, deterministic polyphony/limits, device changes, latency and underruns are implemented.

checks.name: audio and renderer metrics surface
checks.evidence: Profiler, Rendering Diagnostics and Project Health expose runtime/capability measurements.

checks.name: quality presets affect actual settings
checks.evidence: Performance/Balanced/High/Ultra/PixelArt presets change shadow, pixel density, particle and post-process settings.

checks.name: localized visual/audio editor
checks.evidence: Every new v3.7 editor label is present in English, German and Chinese.

checks.name: documentation declares current capability boundary
checks.evidence: Current docs retain the renderer/audio pipeline and current schema compatibility.
